name: case-pack
title: Investigation evidence pack
for_each: select id,code from cases order by code

sections.title: Selected events
sections.sql: select e.source,e.occurred_at,e.actor,e.action,e.outcome,e.message,l.rationale from event_register e join case_events l on l.event_id=e.id where l.case_id=$1 order by e.occurred_at

sections.title: Operator history
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from history where record_type='case' and record_id=$1 order by created_at

name: source-review
title: Source logging policy review
for_each: select id,name from sources order by name

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where kind='source' and id=$1
